claims: Sean Penn won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor at the 2026 Oscars for his role as Colonel Steven J. Lockjaw in "One Battle After Another".
Sean Penn's victory marks his third career Oscar.
Sean Penn had previous wins for Lead Actor.

The nominees for Best Supporting Actor at the 2026 Oscars were Benicio del Toro (One Battle After Another), Jacob Elordi (Frankenstein), Delroy Lindo (Sinners), and Stellan Skarsgård (Sentimental Value).
One Battle After Another was directed by Paul Thomas Anderson.
Sean Penn secured the Actor Award (Instagram reel) prior to the 2026 Oscars ceremony.
Sean Penn was not in attendance at the Dolby Theatre to accept the award.
Kieran Culkin accepted the award on Sean Penn's behalf.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress at the 2026 Oscars for Weapons.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars for Sinners.
